Native R delay embedding, divergence, explicit Lyapunov fits and RQA population bootstrap

etr_native_divergence.Rd

Six independent Python-free scientific implementations for complete multivariate delay embedding, Rosenstein and Kantz local divergence, explicit Lyapunov linear segments and fixed-radius population-average RQA bootstrap.

Usage

etr_delay_embed_trajectory(trajectories, embedding_dimension, delay,
  delay_units = "samples", dimensions = NULL)
etr_local_divergence_curve(embedding, curve, theiler_window, max_horizon,
  theiler_window_units = "samples", max_horizon_units = "samples")
etr_kantz_divergence_curve(embedding, curve, radius, theiler_window,
  max_horizon, min_neighbors = 2L, theiler_window_units = "samples",
  max_horizon_units = "samples")
etr_estimate_largest_lyapunov_rosenstein(divergence, fit_start, fit_end,
  fit_units = "samples")
etr_estimate_largest_lyapunov_kantz(divergence, fit_start, fit_end,
  fit_units = "samples")
etr_bootstrap_rqa_metric_means(trajectories, dimensions, metrics, radius = NULL,
  target_recurrence_rate = NULL, distance_metric = "euclidean",
  theiler_window = 0L, theiler_window_units = "samples",
  min_diagonal_length = 2L, min_vertical_length = 2L,
  embedding_dimension = NULL, delay = NULL, delay_units = "samples",
  unit = "curve", participant_column = NULL, confidence_level = 0.95,
  n_bootstrap = 2000L, random_state = 0L)

Arguments

trajectories

Complete native trajectory collection, no implicit interpolation or smoothing.

embedding_dimension

Explicit number of delay-coordinate blocks; reconstruction with at least two states.

delay

Positive observed-sample lag or physical-time lag.

delay_units

samples, seconds/milliseconds source aliases or matching trajectory time units; physical-time lag requires a regular grid and exact integer sample multiple.

dimensions

Nonempty unique named source channels.

embedding

Native etr_delay_embedding_set from the explicit stage-17 constructor.

curve

Zero-based source index or exact curve ID.

theiler_window

Nonnegative sample exclusion around each state.

max_horizon

Positive number of forward observed-sample horizons.

theiler_window_units

Sample or convertible physical time units, resolved on the embedded grid.

max_horizon_units

Sample or convertible physical time units, resolved on the embedded grid.

radius

Declared nonnegative recurrence radius or positive Kantz neighborhood radius.

min_neighbors

Minimum fixed-radius Kantz neighbors per reference state.

divergence

Native local or Kantz divergence curve, as appropriate.

fit_start

Explicit inclusive first horizon in samples.

fit_end

Explicit inclusive last horizon in samples, with at least three finite points.

fit_units

Only samples.

metrics

Explicit supported RQA metrics; unknown or undefined metrics error.

target_recurrence_rate

Unsupported source adaptive-threshold option; errors rather than silently substituting a fixed radius.

distance_metric

Euclidean only.

min_diagonal_length

Positive RQA diagonal-line threshold.

min_vertical_length

Positive RQA vertical-line threshold.

unit

Independent curve or participant unit for population-average RQA bootstrap.

participant_column

Required participant metadata field for independent participant averages.

confidence_level

Nominal percentile interval level in (0,1).

n_bootstrap

At least 100 whole-unit resampling replicates.

random_state

Scoped base-R random seed; does not reproduce NumPy random streams.

Value

A native delayed trajectory embedding, divergence trace, explicit slope estimate, or curve/participant-level RQA bootstrap result.

Details

No chaos or causal interpretation follows solely from positive Lyapunov slope estimates. Divergence nearest-neighbor ties can differ from SciPy KDTree tie policies; source comparisons avoid tied fixture states. Unsupported adaptive thresholds and non-convertible time-unit lags fail explicitly; valid time-unit lags resolve only to existing samples without interpolation. The RQA bootstrap estimates the mean of per-curve summaries across independent curves or equal-weight participant averages, not uncertainty within one recurrence plot. Bootstrap RNG differs from NumPy. Mapped public names are not 508-contract certification.
